title: Supporting tensor realization comparison structures
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and a continuous rational base $X$ on the pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $J=J^{\mathrm{pbc}}I$ be the composite of the finite-stage identity equivalence [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison] and the continuous rational realization [lem-per-continuous-rational-derived-realization], on the raw rationalized category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], with values in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; let $L_E$ be its ordinary coefficient extension on integral representatives, termwise and derived, with its universal cochain counit. Choose once a normalized tensor-completion presentation [def-sf-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation], which exists by [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion]; its ordinary tensor, K-flat model and completion map, and the inverse of that map on constructible pairs, are fixed thereby, and the rational tensor of integral objects is the localized completed tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. A tensor comparison At for $E$ consists of an ambient ringed-site model [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], natural isomorphisms $J(P\otimes Q)\cong J(P)\otimes J(Q)$ and $J(\mathbf 1)\cong\mathbf 1$, an integral normalization, an ordinary tensor comparison for $L_E$ with a balanced cochain isomorphism pinned on tensor generators and K-flat models, and the equations: integral-tensor normalization through the completion inverse, fractions, associativity, both unit laws and symmetry. For $E\subset F$, FieldChange of two such comparisons asks for a comparison of raw scalar extension with $F_T\otimes^L_{E_T}-$ pinned to the recorded scalar comparisons [def-zl-pbc-finite-raw-scalar-comparison], ordinary tensor, unit and balanced cochain comparisons pinned on generators, and compatibility with the rational tensor and unit scalar comparisons [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. A System is a comparison At for every finite field together with FieldChange for every inclusion. This defines data and equations, without asserting existence.
